lines: If I follow these tears now, helplessly, endlessly overflowing,
I can meet you there, inside my memories
The words I never could, never could say honestly, all this time
Thank you, truly
Ah, the town where I was born and raised, the headstrong passion I built up there
Whenever things didn't go my way, I couldn't believe in myself
But in those times, the sight of you, sweating away at your work,
captivated me, saved me, again and again
Even when it was out of reach I chased it, fell on my face like a fool,
and you were teaching me how precious it is never to give up
If I follow these tears now, helplessly, endlessly overflowing,
I can meet you there, inside my memories
You wrapped me in a kindness and a sternness that never changed,
thank you, truly
Not everything you said and did was right — and still,
there was heart in it, there was heat, and that was what embarrassed me so
To you, showing me the way, I was always talking back,
asserting myself, taking the long way round, getting lost
Fighting you, getting hurt, swept along, losing sight of everything,
I think I've come to understand a little of how precious it is never to give up
If I follow these tears now, helplessly, endlessly overflowing,
I can meet you there, inside my memories
To you, whom I loved and couldn't stand, the words I couldn't say:
thank you, truly
Even when trying hard hurts, I can break into a run,
surely, surely, just like you
If I follow these tears now, helplessly, endlessly overflowing,
I can meet you there, inside my memories
The words I never could, never could say honestly, all this time
Thank you, truly
Thank you
